question: In December 2024, at the King Cup Internaonal Badminton Open, whom did Lakshya Sen defeat to claim the third place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alex Lanier**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **King Cup International Badminton Open:** The tournament is widely recognized as one of the prestigious badminton events, attracting top players globally to compete for titles across multiple categories.
 
• **December 2024:** This specific edition of the King Cup International Badminton Open took place during this month, with players competing for top honors in the tournament.
 
• **Lakshya Sen:** An emerging badminton star from **India**, Lakshya Sen has consistently delivered remarkable performances in international tournaments, establishing himself as a key player in the global badminton circuit.
 
• **Third Place:** In this tournament, Lakshya Sen competed in the playoff match for the third position after missing out on the finals, successfully defeating **Alex Lanier** to secure the third spot.
 
• **Alex Lanier:** The French badminton player is known for his promising talent and significant performances in international competitions. Despite his valiant effort, he was defeated by Lakshya Sen in the third-place playoff match in December 2024.
 
• **Significance of Victory:** Securing third place in this prestigious tournament further solidified Lakshya Sen’s reputation as one of the leading badminton players representing India on the global stage.
 
• **Incorrect Options:** Viktor Axelsen, Kento Momota, and Anthony Sinisuka Ginting are prominent badminton players, but they were not defeated by Lakshya Sen in the third-place playoff match of this specific tournament.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Alex Lanier.***

• **Age:** Born on **16 August 2001**, Lakshya Sen is a young badminton talent from **Almora, Uttarakhand, India**.

• **Career Highlights:** Lakshya Sen was a bronze medalist at the **2021 World Championships** and has consistently performed at a high level in international badminton competitions.
 
 
 
• **Alex Lanier:**
 
 
• **Nationality:** Alex Lanier is a **French badminton player**, recognized for his emerging talent in the sport.
 
• **Performance:** He has competed in several international tournaments and is regarded as one of the promising young players in the badminton circuit.
 
 
 
• **Other Players Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Viktor Axelsen:** A top-ranked player from **Denmark**, known for his dominance in men’s singles badminton.
 
• **Kento Momota:** A former World Champion from **Japan**, celebrated for his exceptional skills and achievements in badminton.
 
• **Anthony Sinisuka Ginting:** An Indonesian badminton player who has demonstrated remarkable performances on the international stage, particularly in men’s singles.
